rationale: Ground truth is thin (mostly non-technical banter plus one inline nit about the reduce_scatter hasattr checks, which the diff already added), so recall is low for both. X engages more with the reduce_scatter/device_communicator mechanics the inline comment concerns, and offers five concrete, file/line-anchored, actionable suggestions (test ordering brittleness, unconditional DP override, redundant gather, error message leak, version guard) that are plausible and grounded in the diff. Y is more concise and verified core design claims against actual vLLM source (a nice touch), but surfaces only one minor actionable comment and otherwise reads as a confidence-affirming approval rather than a review turning up concrete issues. X's greater actionable specificity edges it ahead.
